slide 1: "ECDSA/crypto's mystery numbers (seeds) were just timestamps" is not supported by SOURCE. Seeds were outputs of lrand48 seeded by a timestamp, not 'just timestamps'; also the binary-curve B-163 seed remains unexplained; reword to 'generated from timestamps' and avoid implying all were explained.
